title: [LF] Literal Flowers
description: This pack changes the texture of some flower textures whose colors don't match their dyes in crafting. also, white tulip is renamed to gray tulip!
body:
**This project changes the colors of some flowers to match their dyes in crafting, and renames white tulip to gray tulip.**

<details>
<summary>🌷 Torchflower Texture</summary>

![torchflower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dcc4185e4c3f55f79e2275e975049a5acb1e9fd.jpeg)
</details>

<details>
<summary>🌼 New White Tulip Name</summary>

!["Gray" Tulip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1ec1b49544610e6bdedd01e74cbaa75283bda76.png)
</details>

## 🛑 Beware:
If you are using a language that is NOT any variant of English (e.g., US, UK, AU.), white tulip will stay as "White Tulip" and not be renamed to "Gray Tulip".

# 🔩 Supports:
- 1.21.9-1.21.11
- Would likely NOT Work if another texture pack that changes **flower textures** is ABOVE this pack on the pack list.

# 🎈 More Info:

<details>
<summary>🧰 Updates</summary>
We will update the pack as quickly as we can after a new Minecraft version comes out.
</details>

<details>
<summary>⚙ Installation</summary>

<details>
<summary>🎨 Altering, Customizing, and Uploading the Pack</summary>
You can change assets inside the pack, but you cannot upload it anywhere (Modrinth, Curseforge, Social Media, etc.). Use it for yourself and the people you know. If you want to create addons/extensions for my packs, please delete all the assets I made, then upload your own anywhere you'd like.
</details>
